name: Deskhand art family
subject: Paper documents from one support ticket: a reply sheet 760 x 940 px at master scale with three highlighted claims, and source documents 480 px wide (help article, order, payments). Sheets have 24 px corners, a hairline edge and a white top-edge highlight. Text is greeked as rounded ink bars; cited words are dark bars under a highlighter stroke. A source line is a cubic curve from an open ring at the reply edge to a filled dot at the source line.
lighting: No photography. One soft light from above: each sheet casts a 2 px contact shadow and a 28 px ambient shadow at ink 9 to 11 percent, and carries a white top-edge highlight.
materials: Matte white paper, hairline rules, flat untextured fields, and highlighter strokes with chisel ends and slightly uneven long edges, multiplied over the paper.
illustration: Flat editorial view, straight on. Sheets tilt between -4 and 4 degrees; the reply sheet stays nearly level. Highlighter covers whole words, never half a word. Every highlight in a reply has one source line to one source document. Keep at least 40 percent of a background free of marks for copy.
exclusions: Readable text, logos or numbers inside the art; headlines and data stay as live text
Purple gradients, glowing orbs and generic abstract blobs
Invented metrics, customer logos or people
Decorative images that carry no information in a place where content images belong
